retrievalProfile.description: A dark, minimalist composition featuring multiple full-body figures isolated in vertical beams of light, each treated with a distinct high-contrast duotone color map.
excludeWhen: soft pastel color palettes are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: Four full-body male figures in urban fashion are arranged horizontally across a pitch-black canvas. Each figure is centered within a soft, vertical white light beam that fades at the top and bottom. The figures are rendered in vibrant, saturated duotone colors (yellow, pink, blue, green) with high-contrast shadows and a subtle outer glow that matches their specific color.
coreVisualRelationships: Repetitive vertical light beams creating a rhythmic horizontal sequence
High-contrast duotone figures against a deep black void
Saturated color-coding for each individual subject
Floating, grounded-less perspective for all elements
coreInvariants: Pitch black background with fine grain
Vertical white light beams with soft feathered edges
High-contrast lighting on subjects to emphasize texture and form
Outer glow effect around each silhouette

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four figures of equal scale distributed evenly along the horizontal axis, centered vertically.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central gap between the second and third figures, occasionally occupied by smaller secondary elements like floating heads.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: A linear horizontal scan from left to right, following the sequence of colored spotlights.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dominant black negative space surrounding the central horizontal band of light.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: High-saturation CMYK-adjacent hues: Yellow, Magenta/Pink, Cyan/Blue, and Green.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Red (used for small central focal points)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme saturation within the subjects contrasted against zero-saturation background.
paletteRestrictions: No mid-tone grays in the background
Strict duotone or gradient map application per figure

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a pitch-black textured background with four vertical, soft-edged white light beams spaced evenly. Place four figures in urban streetwear (puffer jackets, vests, jeans) inside the beams.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply high-contrast gradient maps to each figure: Yellow/Black, Pink/Blue, Blue/Navy, and Green/Black. Add a subtle 5px outer glow to each figure matching its primary color.

verificationChecks: Are the figures isolated from the background?
Is each figure a different high-saturation color?
Are the light beams vertical and soft-edged?
Is the background pure black with subtle grain?

adjustableVariables: Width and intensity of light beams
mustRedesign: Any recognizable brand logos on clothing
postGenerationChecks: Check for consistent scale across all four figures.
Ensure the grain texture is uniform across the black areas.
Verify that the outer glow does not bleed excessively into the black space.
Confirm that each figure's color is distinct and highly saturated.
recipe.reuseFormula: Isolated [Subject Type] + Vertical [Light Beam Color] + [Duotone Color Palette] + Black Grainy Background
